title: End-to-End Natural-Language Gold Medal at IMO 2025
aiSystem: Gemini Deep Think (Google DeepMind) & OpenAI Experimental Model
whyItMatters: Just one year after specialized formal systems earned IMO silver, general-purpose LLMs solved 5 of 6 IMO problems in plain English within the official 4.5-hour limit.
summary: In July 2025, Google DeepMind's advanced Gemini with Deep Think officially achieved gold-medal standard (35/42 points, solving 5 of 6 problems perfectly) at the 2025 International Mathematical Olympiad—graded directly by official IMO coordinators. Operating end-to-end in natural language with zero human translation to Lean and within the strict 4.5-hour human time limit, alongside a concurrent gold-level claim by OpenAI, this marked the inflection point from narrow theorem provers to general mathematical reasoning.
technicalHighlights: Official IMO graders certified 35/42 points—describing the proofs as clear, precise, and easy to follow.
Eliminated the human-in-the-loop Lean translation bottleneck and 2–3 day runtime required by AlphaProof at IMO 2024.
Foreshadowed the 2026 wave of frontier research-level mathematical proofs.
caveats: Olympiad problems are self-contained puzzles with known solutions rather than open research conjectures; nonetheless, the leap in 12 months reset nearly every expert timeline.
contributors: Google DeepMind Gemini Deep Think Team

scoreRationale.foundational: Proved general-purpose natural-language reasoning models could perform creative, competition-grade mathematical proof synthesis.
scoreRationale.ripple: Directly paved the way for 2026 research-level AI mathematicians across Lean formalization and open problems.
scoreRationale.verification: Officially graded by IMO organizers using the exact human competition rules and time constraints.
scoreRationale.velocity: Jumped from specialized formal silver (2024) to general natural-language gold (2025) in exactly 12 months.
